verses.en: I will extol thee, my God, O king; and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.
verses.pt: Eu te exaltarei, meu Deus e Rei; e bendirei teu nome para todo o sempre.
verses.en_web: I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.
verses.en_bbe: <A Song of praise. Of David.> Let me give glory to you, O God, my King; and blessing to your name for ever and ever.

verses.en: Every day will I bless thee; and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.
verses.pt: Todo dia eu te bendirei, e louvarei teu nome para todo o sempre.
verses.en_web: Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever.
verses.en_bbe: Every day will I give you blessing, praising your name for ever and ever.

verses.en: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.
verses.pt: O SENHOR é grande e muito louvável; sua grandeza é incompreensível.
verses.en_web: Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.
verses.en_bbe: Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised; his power may never be searched out.

verses.en: One generation shall praise thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts.
verses.pt: Geração após geração louvará tuas obras, e anunciarão tuas proezas.
verses.en_web: One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.
verses.en_bbe: One generation after another will give praise to your great acts, and make clear the operation of your strength.

verses.en: I will speak of the glorious honour of thy majesty, and of thy wondrous works.
verses.pt: Eu falarei da honra gloriosa de tua majestade, e de teus feitos maravilhosos.
verses.en_web: Of the glorious majesty of your honor, of your wondrous works, I will meditate.
verses.en_bbe: My thoughts will be of the honour and glory of your rule, and of the wonder of your works.

verses.en: And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: and I will declare thy greatness.
verses.pt: E falarão do poder de teus assombrosos feitos; e eu contarei tua grandeza.
verses.en_web: Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts. I will declare your greatness.
verses.en_bbe: Men will be talking of the power and fear of your acts; I will give word of your glory.

verses.en: They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness, and shall sing of thy righteousness.
verses.pt: Declararão a lembrança de tua grande bondade; e anunciarão tua justiça alegremente.
verses.en_web: They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.
verses.en_bbe: Their sayings will be full of the memory of all your mercy, and they will make songs of your righteousness.

verses.en: The LORD is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.
verses.pt: Piedoso e misericordioso é o SENHOR; ele demora para se irar, e tem grande bondade.
verses.en_web: Yahweh is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord is full of grace and pity; not quickly angry, but great in mercy.

verses.en: The LORD is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.
verses.pt: O SENHOR é bom para com todos; e suas misericórdias estão sobre todas as obras que ele fez.
verses.en_web: Yahweh is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord is good to all men; and his mercies are over all his works.

verses.en: All thy works shall praise thee, O LORD; and thy saints shall bless thee.
verses.pt: Todas as tuas obras louvarão a ti, SENHOR; e teus santos te bendirão.
verses.en_web: All your works will give thanks to you, Yahweh. Your saints will extol you.
verses.en_bbe: All the works of your hands give praise to you, O Lord; and your saints give you blessing.

verses.en: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, and talk of thy power;
verses.pt: Contarão a glória de teu reino, e falarão de teu poder.
verses.en_web: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk about your power;
verses.en_bbe: Their words will be of the glory of your kingdom, and their talk of your strength;

verses.en: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.
verses.pt: Para anunciarem aos filhos dos homens suas proezas, e a honra gloriosa de seu reino.
verses.en_web: to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.
verses.en_bbe: So that the sons of men may have knowledge of his acts of power, and of the great glory of his kingdom.

verses.en: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.
verses.pt: Teu reino é um reino eterno, e teu domínio dura geração após geração.
verses.en_web: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. Yahweh is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds.
verses.en_bbe: Your kingdom is an eternal kingdom, and your rule is through all generations.

verses.en: The LORD upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all those that be bowed down.
verses.pt: O SENHOR segura todos os que caem, e levanta todos os abatidos.
verses.en_web: Yahweh upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord is the support of all who are crushed, and the lifter up of all who are bent down.

verses.en: The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their meat in due season.
verses.pt: Os olhos de todos esperam por ti, e tu lhes dás seu alimento ao seu tempo.
verses.en_web: The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.
verses.en_bbe: The eyes of all men are waiting for you; and you give them their food in its time.

verses.en: Thou openest thine hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.
verses.pt: Tu abres tua mão, e sacias o desejo de todo ser vivo.
verses.en_web: You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
verses.en_bbe: By the opening of your hand, every living thing has its desire in full measure.

verses.en: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.
verses.pt: O SENHOR é justo em todos os seus caminhos, e bondoso em todas as suas obras.
verses.en_web: Yahweh is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord is upright in all his ways, and kind in all his works.

verses.en: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.
verses.pt: O SENHOR está perto de todos os que o chamam; de todos os que clamam a ele sinceramente.
verses.en_web: Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord is near all those who give honour to his name; even to all who give honour to him with true hearts.

verses.en: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them.
verses.pt: Ele faz a vontade dos que o temem; e ouve o clamor deles, e os salva.
verses.en_web: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.
verses.en_bbe: To his worshippers, he will give their desire; their cry comes to his ears, and he gives them salvation.

verses.en: The LORD preserveth all them that love him: but all the wicked will he destroy.
verses.pt: O SENHOR protege a todos os que o amam; porém destrói a todos os perversos.
verses.en_web: Yahweh preserves all those who love him, but all the wicked he will destroy.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord will keep all his worshippers from danger; but he will send destruction on all sinners.

verses.en: My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD: and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.
verses.pt: Minha boca anunciará louvores ao SENHOR; e todo ser feito de carne louvará seu santo nome para todo o sempre.
verses.en_web: My mouth will speak the praise of Yahweh. Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.
verses.en_bbe: My mouth will give praise to the Lord; let all flesh be blessing his holy name for ever and ever.
